name: @yousim/core
comment:private: Not published. `yousim` is the only package that ships; bun build --target node inlines this one into it.
description: Core simulation logic for YouSim - provider-agnostic identity simulator
comment:storage-driver: exports["./storage/driver"] is the one genuine Node/Bun fork in this
package. Bun has bun:sqlite and no node:sqlite; Node has node:sqlite and
no bun:sqlite, so a single import cannot cover both. The resolver
chooses, not the code: nothing in src/storage/sqlite.ts branches and
there is no `typeof Bun` check. "default" is the Node driver because
every non-Bun runtime that can run this package at all is Node.
Note this cannot be a comment key inside `exports` itself - Node rejects
an exports map that mixes "."-prefixed keys with anything else.
